name: bigbasket-mcp
description: Shop on BigBasket from Claude: search the catalogue, manage the cart, pick an address and drive checkout.
long_description: Runs a real browser session against bigbasket.com and calls BigBasket's own web APIs from inside it, so cookies, CSRF and bot-protection tokens stay valid. Tools cover login by OTP, delivery location, catalogue search, cart edits and the checkout flow.

tools.name: check_login
tools.description: Check whether the saved session is signed in

tools.name: login
tools.description: Start login and request an OTP

tools.name: set_location
tools.description: Set delivery location by area, landmark or pincode

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the catalogue for one product

tools.name: suggest
tools.description: Search suggestions for a vague term

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Add, update or remove cart items in one call

tools.name: get_past_order_items
tools.description: Items bought before, from Smart Basket

tools.name: select_payment_method
tools.description: Choose cod, upi, wallet, card or netbanking

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Preview the order, or place it on confirmation
